map.从 n 个元素取 r 个的组合数。: The number of combinations of r items chosen from n elements.
map.在概率题中算事件发生的方式数（分母）: Counts the number of ways an event can occur in a probability problem (the denominator)
map.恒成立：从 n 个里选 k 个留下，等价于选 n-k 个拿走，二者一一对应，故: Always true: choosing k of n to keep is equivalent to choosing n-k to remove, and the two correspond one to one, so C(n,k)=C(n,n-k).
map.由两三维向量求点积: Dot product of two or three dimensional vectors
map.由二阶矩阵四元素求行列式: Determinant from the four elements of a 2x2 matrix
map.由类型数与选取数求可重复组合数: Combinations with repetition from type count and pick count
map.组合不计顺序（选出来即可），排列计顺序（谁先谁后不同）。公式上 C(n,k)=P: Combinations ignore order (only the selection matters), permutations count order (who comes first changes things). Formally C(n,k)=P(n,k)/k!, which divides out the order repetitions.
map.组合和排列的核心区别？: What is the core difference between combinations and permutations?
map.组合数计算器求从 n 个元素中选取 r 个的组合数 C(n,r)，支持大数运算，: Combination calculator computes C(n,r), the number of ways to choose r items from n elements, supports large numbers, and suits probability, lottery and combinatorial calculations.
map.计算从 n 个里选 k 个且不计顺序的选法数，如抽签、组队: Counts the ways to choose k from n ignoring order, such as draws and team selection
map.评估彩票或抽奖的可能结果数量: Estimate how many outcomes a lottery or draw can have
map.：从 5 人中选 2 人，组合数 C(5,2)=5!/(2!×3!)=(5×4): : choosing 2 from 5 people gives C(5,2)=5!/(2!×3!)=(5×4)/(2×1)=10. Unlike permutations, {A,B} and {B,A} count as the same.
map.：同样 5 选 2，若顺序有关（如冠亚军）则用排列 P(5,2)=5×4=20，: : for the same choose-2-of-5, if order matters (such as champion and runner-up) use the permutation P(5,2)=5×4=20, twice the combination count, because each pair has two orders.
